location: accepted manuscript p. 7, Methods (Airbnb data); p. 11, Confirmatory analyses (Table 3, Model 2)
quote: Due to resource constraints, we randomly sampled 1,020 listings from the pool of remaining listings. Our analyses are based on this final sample of listings.
reason: The critical regression test predicting listing price from host attractiveness was conducted on 1,020 Airbnb listings (t(1,010) = 2.34). The shipped value (443) is the number of MTurk participants who rated host attractiveness during stimulus preparation rather than the analytic sample size of the regression.

quote: Our results do not replicate findings by Ert and colleagues (2016; Study 1)
reason: The authors explicitly state that their results do not replicate Ert et al. (2016; Study 1), noting that in contrast to the original study they found a positive main effect of attractiveness but no main effect of trustworthiness or interaction.
